purpose: Define how external boss content will feed augmentation core progression without modifying third-party JARs by default.

reward_bands.intent: A real boss should normally feel better than routine exploration.
Major bosses are a direct route into high-grade augmentation progression.
Pinnacle bosses can expose mythic cores before or around the Ender Dragon era without making mythic routine.

sources.reward_assignment: per-boss mapping deferred until gameplay difficulty is measured
